text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Okay♪ My Darlin' Prince, it's time for the grand finale! We'll do this together, okay? Please join me in singin' along~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいな♪　
王子はん、
いよいよ大詰めどす！
最後は二人でいきますえ？
ご唱和
おたの申します～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
In it's most mighty extravagant version!
Mira-cle~ Maho-rin~... KURURINPA~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とびっきりの
大盤振る舞いバージョンや～！
みらくるまほりん、
くるりんぱ～！
